name: Sensor & Module Kit
desc: كيت مستشعرات وموديولات إلكترونية يضم 14 مكونًا متنوعًا لمشروعات الأردوينو والروبوتات. يشمل مستشعرات الحرارة والرطوبة والضوء والصوت واللهب والغازات والحركة والمسافات، بالإضافة إلى وحدات التوقيت والتحكم بالجوستيك وتتبع الخط ورطوبة التربة. مناسب للتعلم والتجارب العملية ومشروعات الإلكترونيات التفاعلية

blocks.text: اكتشف إمكانيات الإلكترونيات والبرمجة مع Arduino Sensor & Module Kit، وهو كيت متنوع يضم 14 مستشعرًا وموديولًا إلكترونيًا لتجربة أنواع مختلفة من القياس، واكتشاف الحركة والعوائق، والتحكم، وتنفيذ المشروعات التفاعلية باستخدام الأردوينو ولوحات التطوير المتوافقة.
يوفر الكيت مجموعة من المكونات التي تساعدك على فهم كيفية جمع البيانات من البيئة المحيطة، واستخدام هذه البيانات في تشغيل أنظمة التنبيه، وقياس المسافات، والتحكم في الروبوتات، ومراقبة ظروف البيئة.
مميزات الكيت
قياس درجة الحرارة والرطوبة: باستخدام مستشعر DHT11 ومستشعر الحرارة LM35.
اكتشاف الضوء واللهب والغازات: باستخدام LDR Light Sensor وFlame Sensor وMQ Gas Sensor.
اكتشاف الحركة والعوائق: باستخدام مستشعر PIR ومستشعر المسافة HC-SR04.
مشروعات الروبوتات: باستخدام PS2 Joystick Module ومستشعر تتبع الخط TCRT5000 خماسي القنوات.
مراقبة التربة: باستخدام مستشعر رطوبة التربة السعوي.
مشروعات التوقيت: باستخدام وحدة DS1302 Real-Time Clock لحساب الوقت والتاريخ.
التجارب التفاعلية: باستخدام مستشعر الصوت، ومستشعر الميل والاهتزاز، ووحدة الليزر KY-008.
محتويات الكيت
Microphone Sound Sensor Module — مستشعر الصوت.
DHT11 Temperature & Humidity Sensor — مستشعر الحرارة والرطوبة.
Flame Sensor Module — مستشعر اللهب.
LDR Light Sensor Module — مستشعر الضوء.
DS1302 Real-Time Clock (RTC) Module with Battery — وحدة الساعة الرقمية.
MQ Gas Sensor Module — مستشعر الغازات.
PS2 Joystick Module — وحدة عصا التحكم.
HC-SR501 PIR Motion Sensor — مستشعر الحركة.
HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Distance Sensor — مستشعر قياس المسافات.
Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensor — مستشعر رطوبة التربة.
KY-008 Laser Transmitter Module 5V — وحدة إرسال الليزر الأحمر.
LM35 Precision Centigrade Temperature Sensor — مستشعر الحرارة LM35.
SW-520D Tilt & Vibration Sensor Module — مستشعر الميل والاهتزاز.
TCRT5000 5-Channel Infrared Line Tracking Sensor Module — مستشعر تتبع الخط خماسي القنوات.
المشروعات التي يمكنك تنفيذها
نظام لقياس درجة الحرارة والرطوبة.
نظام تنبيه تجريبي عند اكتشاف اللهب أو تغير قراءات مستشعر الغاز.
نظام إضاءة يعتمد على شدة الضوء.
نظام كشف الحركة والمسافات.
مشروع روبوت لتتبع الخطوط والتحكم في الحركة.
نظام لمراقبة رطوبة التربة.
مشروعات تعتمد على التوقيت والتحكم باستخدام عصا التحكم.
لمن يناسب هذا الكيت؟
مناسب لطلاب المدارس والجامعات، والمبتدئين في الإلكترونيات، وهواة الأردوينو والروبوتات، وكل من يرغب في تجربة أنواع متعددة من المستشعرات وتطوير مهارات البرمجة والتحكم الإلكتروني.
مجموعة متنوعة من المستشعرات والموديولات تساعدك على تجربة أفكار جديدة وتحويلها إلى مشروعات إلكترونية عملية.

name: كيت ESP32 لإنترنت الأشياء والمنزل الذكي – ESP32 IoT & Smart Home Starter Kit
desc: كيت ESP32 متكامل لتعلم البرمجة وإنترنت الأشياء والمشروعات الذكية. يحتوي على لوحة ESP32 DevKit V1، وشاشة LCD 16×2، ومستشعر DHT11، ومستشعر حركة PIR، ومستشعر رطوبة التربة، بالإضافة إلى Breadboard وأسلاك توصيل وليدات ومقاومات وأزرار ضغط ووحدة Relay. مناسب للمبتدئين والطلاب وهواة الإلكترونيات لتنفيذ مشروعات المنزل الذكي والتحكم اللاسلكي.

blocks.text: اسم المنتج
كيت ESP32 لإنترنت الأشياء والمنزل الذكي – ESP32 IoT & Smart Home Starter Kit

مستشعر PIR HC-SR501: لاكتشاف الحركة وتنفيذ مشروعات الإنذار.
مستشعر رطوبة التربة: لمراقبة رطوبة التربة وتجربة تطبيقات الري الذكي.
Breadboard وأسلاك التوصيل: لتجميع الدوائر وتوصيل المكونات بسهولة.
LEDs ومقاومات وأزرار ضغط: لتنفيذ التجارب الأساسية والتحكم في الإشارات الضوئية.

name: 🤖 LINE FOLLOWER ROBOT
desc: كيت روبوت تتبع الخط باستخدام Arduino UNO R3 SMD، مزود بـ 3 مستشعرات أشعة تحت الحمراء (IR) ودرايفر L298D للتحكم في المحركات. يحتوي على هيكل سيارة ومحركات وعجلات وأسلاك توصيل وبطاريتين 18650 مع حامل بطاريات. مثالي لتعلّم برمجة الأردوينو وأساسيات الروبوتات والتحكم الآلي من خلال التجارب العملية.

name: Smart Car Kit
desc: كيت سيارة روبوت ذكية بنظام الدفع الرباعي 4WD، مزودة بوحدة ESP32-CAM للتحكم اللاسلكي وبث الفيديو المباشر عبر Wi-Fi، ومستشعرات لاكتشاف العوائق وقياس المسافات، ومحرك سيرفو، ووحدة للتحكم في المحركات. مثالي لتعلم البرمجة والإلكترونيات والروبوتات وتنفيذ مشاريع DIY تعليمية.

blocks.text: كيت السيارة الروبوت الذكية ESP32-CAM بنظام الدفع الرباعي 4WD

اكتشف عالم الإلكترونيات والروبوتات مع كيت السيارة الروبوت الذكية ESP32-CAM 4WD من ElectroHub! يتيح لك هذا الكيت تجميع وبرمجة سيارة روبوت ذكية تجمع بين التحكم اللاسلكي، وبث الفيديو المباشر، واستشعار المسافات، والتحكم في المحركات.

يعتمد الكيت على وحدة ESP32-CAM المزودة بكاميرا، والتي تتيح التحكم في السيارة لاسلكيًا وبث الفيديو عبر شبكة Wi-Fi بعد إعداد البرنامج المناسب. كما يحتوي على مستشعر الموجات فوق الصوتية HC-SR04 لقياس المسافات واكتشاف العوائق، بالإضافة إلى محرك السيرفو SG90 الذي يمكن استخدامه لتحريك المستشعر أو الكاميرا حسب تصميم المشروع.
سواء كنت طالبًا أو مبتدئًا في مجال الإلكترونيات أو من هواة الروبوتات، فهذا الكيت يمنحك فرصة عملية لتعلم البرمجة والتحكم في المحركات والتعامل مع المستشعرات وبناء مشاريع روبوتية تفاعلية.
المميزات الرئيسية
التحكم اللاسلكي عبر Wi-Fi: إمكانية التحكم في حركة السيارة من خلال واجهة تحكم متوافقة، مع بث الفيديو المباشر من الكاميرا بعد إعداد النظام وبرمجته.

خفض الجهد المستمر DC إلى جهد أقل قابل للضبط.
شاشة LED رقمية لعرض الجهد.
إمكانية ضبط جهد الخرج بسهولة.
كفاءة تحويل عالية مقارنة بمنظمات الجهد الخطية.
مناسبة لمشروعات Arduino وESP32 والأنظمة الإلكترونية.
تصميم مدمج وسهل التركيب.

تغذية لوحات Arduino وESP32.
مشروعات الروبوتات والإلكترونيات.
أنظمة الطاقة والبطاريات.
تشغيل الدوائر الإلكترونية التي تحتاج إلى جهد أقل.
مشروعات إنترنت الأشياء (IoT).
المواصفات الفنية
نوع الوحدة: DC-DC Step-Down (Buck Converter).
الشريحة الرئيسية: LM2596.
جهد الخرج: قابل للضبط.
عرض الجهد: شاشة LED رقمية.
نوع التحويل: خفض الجهد المستمر.
ملاحظة: تختلف حدود جهد الدخل والخرج والتيار الأقصى حسب إصدار الوحدة وتصميمها. يجب ضبط جهد الخرج وقياسه قبل توصيل أي جهاز إلكتروني، مع مراعاة التبريد والتيار المسموح به.

Adjustable DC step-down voltage conversion.
Digital LED voltage display.
Easy output voltage adjustment.

name: TCRT5000 IR Line Tracking Sensor Module

blocks.text: وحدة تتبع الخط بالأشعة تحت الحمراء TCRT5000 IR Line Tracking Sensor Module
الوصف بالعربي

وحدة TCRT5000 هي مستشعر إلكتروني يعتمد على الأشعة تحت الحمراء لاكتشاف الخطوط والأسطح المختلفة من خلال قياس الضوء المنعكس عنها. تحتوي الوحدة على باعث للأشعة تحت الحمراء ومستقبل ضوئي، مما يسمح لها بالتمييز بين الأسطح الفاتحة والداكنة بناءً على اختلاف انعكاس الضوء.

تُستخدم الوحدة بشكل أساسي في روبوتات تتبع الخط (Line Follower Robots)، كما يمكن استخدامها في مشروعات اكتشاف الحواف والتحكم الآلي. تتميز بصغر حجمها وسهولة توصيلها مع لوحات Arduino وESP32 وESP8266، حسب توافق جهد التشغيل والإشارة.
المميزات
مستشعر انعكاس بالأشعة تحت الحمراء.
مناسب لاكتشاف الخطوط السوداء والبيضاء.
يساعد على التمييز بين الأسطح حسب انعكاس الضوء.
تصميم صغير وسهل التركيب.
مناسب لمشروعات الروبوتات والإلكترونيات.
سهل التوصيل مع المتحكمات الدقيقة.
التطبيقات
روبوتات تتبع الخط (Line Follower Robots).
اكتشاف الحواف والأسطح.
مشروعات الروبوتات التعليمية.
أنظمة التحكم والحركة الآلية.
مشروعات Arduino وESP32.
تطبيقات اكتشاف الأجسام القريبة من سطح المستشعر.
المواصفات الفنية
نوع المستشعر: Infrared Reflective Sensor.
الشريحة: TCRT5000.
طريقة الاستشعار: الأشعة تحت الحمراء المنعكسة.
الاستخدام الأساسي: تتبع الخطوط واكتشاف اختلاف الأسطح.
ضبط الحساسية: متوفر في بعض إصدارات الوحدة.
نوع الخرج: تناظري أو رقمي حسب تصميم الوحدة.
أطراف التوصيل
قد تختلف الأطراف حسب إصدار الوحدة، وتشمل عادةً:
VCC: مصدر التغذية.
GND: الأرضي.
DO: خرج رقمي، إذا كان متوفرًا.
AO: خرج تناظري، إذا كان متوفرًا.
ملاحظة: تعتمد دقة الاستشعار على المسافة بين المستشعر والسطح، ولون السطح، والإضاءة المحيطة. يُنصح بضبط ارتفاع المستشعر وتجربته على نوع السطح المستخدم للحصول على أفضل أداء.
English Description

The TCRT5000 IR Line Tracking Sensor Module is an infrared reflective sensor designed to detect lines and distinguish surfaces based on reflected infrared light. It uses an infrared emitter and a phototransistor receiver to detect differences in surface reflectivity.

The module is commonly used in line-following robots, educational robotics, and surface detection projects. Its compact design makes it easy to integrate with Arduino, ESP32, and other microcontroller boards, subject to voltage compatibility.
Features
Infrared reflective sensing technology.
Detects differences between light and dark surfaces.
Suitable for line-following applications.
Compact design and easy installation.
Useful for robotics and educational electronics.
Available with digital or analog output, depending on the module version.
Applications
Line-following robots.
Surface and edge detection.
Educational robotics projects.
Automated movement systems.
Arduino and ESP32 projects.
Technical Specifications
Sensor Type: Infrared Reflective Sensor.
Sensor Model: TCRT5000.
Detection Method: Reflected infrared light.
Primary Application: Line tracking and surface detection.
Output Type: Analog or digital, depending on the module version.
Sensitivity Adjustment: Available on selected versions.
Pinout
Depending on the module version, the pins may include:
VCC: Power supply.
GND: Ground.
DO: Digital output, if available.
AO: Analog output, if available.
Note: Detection performance depends on sensor height, surface reflectivity, and ambient lighting. Adjust the sensor position for reliable results.

name: WH148 50K Ohm Rotary Potentiometer with Knob

3-Pin Single Turn Design: Simple three-terminal wiring works directly with Arduino analog inputs or audio circuits.

Commonly used as the classic control potentiometer in Arduino tutorials and DIY audio projects, the WH148 is a reliable, low-cost way to add manual analog control to any circuit.

name: DC-DC Step-Up Boost Converter Module 12A 400W

blocks.text: The DC-DC Step-Up Boost Converter Module 12A 400W is a high-power voltage regulator that boosts a lower DC input to a higher, adjustable output, delivering up to 400 watts continuously. A heavy-duty inductor and finned aluminum heatsink make it suitable for demanding applications like battery banks, solar systems, and motor power supplies.
Key features:
Wide Input Range: Accepts 8.5V to 50V DC input from batteries, solar panels, or other low-voltage sources.
Adjustable Output: Onboard potentiometer sets the output anywhere from 10V to 60V to match the load.
High Current Capacity: Delivers up to 12A of continuous output current for demanding loads.

Ideal for boosting battery or solar voltage to power amplifiers, LED lighting arrays, motor controllers, and other high-current voltage step-up needs.

name: DS18B20 Waterproof Digital Temperature Sensor Probe

blocks.text: The DS18B20 Waterproof Digital Temperature Sensor Probe is a stainless-steel-encased version of the popular DS18B20 sensor, sealed for use in liquids, soil, and other damp or wet environments. Roughly one meter of durable cable is attached, making remote temperature monitoring simple for Arduino, ESP32, and Raspberry Pi projects.
Key features:

Wide Temperature Range: Measures from -55°C to +125°C with ±0.5°C accuracy between -10°C and +85°C.

Commonly used in aquariums, weather stations, 3D printers, and sous-vide cookers, this probe brings reliable digital temperature sensing to any project that needs to measure liquids or the outdoors.

blocks.text: The 9V Battery Snap Connector to DC Female Jack Cable adapts a standard 9V battery snap into a 5.5mm x 2.1mm female DC socket, letting you plug in any device or cable that normally expects a male barrel connector. Lightweight & Portable: Compact design suits battery-powered prototypes, sensor nodes, and field projects.

name: 9V Battery Snap Connector to DC Male Plug Cable

blocks.text: The 9V Battery Snap Connector to DC Male Plug Cable lets you power any project that uses a standard 5.5mm x 2.1mm DC barrel jack directly from a 9V battery. Thermal Protection: Onboard thermal and over-current shutdown protects the amplifier during extended use.

name: 0.56 Inch 4-Digit 7-Segment LED Display Red (5461BS, Common Cathode)

name: IR Wireless Remote Control Kit for Arduino (Receiver + Remote)

name: TTP223 Capacitive Touch Sensor Module

name: W1209 Digital Temperature Controller Module

NTC Temperature Sensing: Reads temperature from -50°C to +110°C using an included waterproof NTC probe.
Onboard Relay Output: Switches loads up to 240V AC at 5A or 12V DC at 10A for heaters, fans, or coolers.
Digital Display: A three-digit LED display shows the current temperature and configuration menu.
Programmable Hysteresis: Adjustable switching hysteresis and activation delay prevent relay chatter near the threshold.
Heating or Cooling Mode: Configurable to activate the relay on rising or falling temperature.
Non-Volatile Memory: Retains all programmed settings after power is removed.
It is widely used to automate incubators, refrigeration units, aquariums, and other temperature-controlled DIY projects.

name: LCD1602 16×2 Character LCD Display Module (Blue Backlight)

blocks.text: The LCD1602 16×2 Character LCD Display Module (Blue Backlight) is a parallel-interface alphanumeric display capable of showing two lines of sixteen characters each. Built around the industry-standard HD44780 controller, it displays white text on a blue background for excellent readability.
Key features:
HD44780 Controller: Uses the industry-standard command set supported by virtually every microcontroller platform.
16×2 Character Grid: Displays two rows of sixteen alphanumeric or custom characters.
Blue Backlight: A built-in LED backlight provides crisp white-on-blue contrast in low-light conditions.
Parallel Interface: Standard 16-pin header supports both 4-bit and 8-bit connection modes.
Contrast Control: A dedicated pin allows contrast adjustment via an external potentiometer.
Wide Compatibility: Works with Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi, and most microcontrollers using standard LCD libraries.
It remains one of the most widely used displays for showing sensor readings, menus, and status messages in electronics projects.

name: Mini Submersible Water Pump 5V DC

blocks.text: The Mini Submersible Water Pump 5V DC is a compact, lightweight pump designed to run fully submerged in water while circulating liquid through a small DC motor and impeller. It is a popular choice for fountains, hydroponics, cooling loops, and Arduino-controlled watering projects.
Key features:
Submersible Operation: Designed to run continuously while fully underwater without leaking.
Low Voltage Supply: Operates directly from a 5V DC source, making it easy to drive from USB power or a battery pack.
Compact and Lightweight: Small physical size fits easily into tabletop fountains, mini aquariums, and DIY enclosures.
Quiet Motor: Runs smoothly with minimal noise and vibration during operation.
Flexible Outlet Tubing: A soft outlet nozzle accepts common aquarium tubing for directing water flow.
Easy Control: Can be switched on and off directly or driven through a transistor or relay from a microcontroller.
It is widely used in mini fountains, cooling systems, hydroponic setups, and automated plant-watering projects.

name: LM393 Photosensitive Light Sensor Module (4-Pin LDR)

blocks.text: The LM393 Photosensitive Light Sensor Module (4-Pin LDR) is a light-detecting board that pairs a light-dependent resistor with an LM393 voltage comparator to sense changes in ambient brightness. It outputs both a digital switching signal and an analog voltage proportional to light intensity.
Key features:
Dual Output: Provides a digital (DO) output for simple light/dark switching and an analog (AO) output for precise brightness readings.
Adjustable Sensitivity: An onboard potentiometer sets the light threshold at which the digital output triggers.
LM393 Comparator: Converts the LDR’s changing resistance into a clean, stable output signal.
Status LEDs: Power and digital-output indicator LEDs make wiring and testing straightforward.
4-Pin Header: Simple VCC, GND, DO, and AO pinout connects directly to any microcontroller.
Low-Cost Automation: Ideal for automatic lighting, day/night detection, and light-following robots.
Its small size and simple interface make it a convenient building block for Arduino, ESP32, and Raspberry Pi light-sensing projects.

name: ESP32-WROOM-32 38-Pin WiFi + Bluetooth Development Board

blocks.text: The ESP32-WROOM-32 38-Pin WiFi + Bluetooth Development Board is a dual-core microcontroller board built around the ESP32-WROOM-32 module, combining Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connectivity in a single low-cost package. Its 38-pin layout breaks out the chip’s I/O for direct use in a solderless breadboard.
Key Features
Microcontroller: ESP32-WROOM-32 dual-core Xtensa LX6 running at up to 240 MHz.
Wireless Connectivity: Integrated 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and Bluetooth 4.2 (Classic and BLE).
Flash Memory: 4MB onboard flash for program storage and OTA updates.
USB Interface: Onboard USB-to-serial chip for programming and power directly from a computer.
Rich I/O: 38 broken-out pins include GPIO, ADC, DAC, PWM, SPI, I2C, and UART.
Arduino Compatible: Programmable through the Arduino IDE, ESP-IDF, and MicroPython.
Package Includes
1 x ESP32-WROOM-32 38-Pin Development Board

name: PCF8574 I2C Serial Interface Adapter Module for 1602/2004 LCD

blocks.text: The PCF8574 I2C Serial Interface Adapter Module for 1602/2004 LCD is a small backpack board that converts a standard parallel-interface character LCD into an I2C device, controlled with just two wires. Built around the PCF8574 I/O expander chip, it dramatically reduces the number of microcontroller pins needed to drive a display.
Key features:
I2C Communication: Uses only SDA and SCL lines to control the LCD, freeing up to ten GPIO pins on the host microcontroller.
PCF8574 I/O Expander: Converts the I2C signal into the parallel data needed by standard HD44780-compatible LCD modules.
Onboard Contrast Adjustment: A built-in potentiometer sets the display contrast without extra external components.
Simple Pin Header: A 16-pin male header solders directly onto the back of common 1602 and 2004 character LCDs.
Configurable I2C Address: Solder jumpers let multiple displays share the same bus without address conflicts.
Wide Compatibility: Works with Arduino, ESP32, ESP8266, and Raspberry Pi using widely available I2C LCD libraries.
This adapter is the standard way to add a character display to a project while keeping wiring simple and pin usage to a minimum.

name: LM2596 DC-DC Adjustable Step-Down Buck Converter Module

blocks.text: The LM2596 DC-DC Adjustable Step-Down Buck Converter Module is a compact switching regulator built around the LM2596 buck converter IC, designed to step down a higher DC input voltage to a stable, user-adjustable output. Its onboard trimmer potentiometer makes it easy to dial in the exact voltage a project needs.
Key features:
High Conversion Efficiency: Delivers switching efficiency up to 92%, generating far less heat than a linear regulator at the same current.
Adjustable Output Voltage: An onboard multi-turn potentiometer allows the output to be tuned anywhere from 1.25V to 37V.
Wide Input Range: Accepts a DC input from 4.5V to 40V, making it suitable for battery packs, solar panels, and wall adapters.
High Current Capability: Supplies up to 3A of continuous output current for motors, LED strips, and other demanding loads.
Built-In Protection: Thermal shutdown and current-limiting circuitry guard the module against overheating and short circuits.
Compact Footprint: A small PCB size fits easily into battery chargers, robotics platforms, and other embedded power supplies.
This module is a popular choice for hobbyists and engineers who need a reliable, low-cost way to regulate power in Arduino, Raspberry Pi, and general electronics projects.

name: DT-06 WiFi to TTL Serial Transparent Transmission Module (ESP-M2, HC-06 Footprint)

blocks.text: The DT-06 WiFi to TTL Serial Transparent Transmission Module is a compact wireless bridge built around the ESP-M2 (ESP8285) WiFi chip, designed to convert any UART serial connection into a WiFi link. It drops straight into projects that already use an HC-06 Bluetooth module, since it shares the same pinout and physical footprint.
Key features:
ESP-M2 WiFi Core: Built on the ESP8285-based ESP-M2 module, supporting 802.11 b/g/n on the 2.4GHz band.
Transparent Transmission: Built-in firmware forwards serial data over WiFi in real time with no extra coding required.
HC-06 Pin-Compatible: Matches the classic Bluetooth module footprint, so it can drop into existing HC-06 wiring.
Flexible Network Modes: Supports AP, STA, and combined AP+STA modes with a built-in web configuration page.
Status Indicator: Onboard LED and STATE pin report the current connection status at a glance.
Wide Input Tolerance: Operates from 4.5V to 6V while keeping TTL logic at a safe, 5V-tolerant 3.3V.
Ideal for adding WiFi control to Arduino, robotics, and IoT projects that need wireless serial communication without redesigning existing Bluetooth wiring.

name: TT Gear Motor with Wheel Set (Yellow, 65mm, Pair)

blocks.text: The TT Gear Motor with Wheel Set pairs two yellow plastic-gear DC motors with matching rubber-tired 65mm wheels, built for small robot cars and DIY chassis projects. Each motor integrates a simple reduction gearbox that trades raw shaft speed for usable torque, driving its attached wheel directly with no extra couplers needed.
Key features:
Ready-to-Mount Wheel: Each motor ships pre-fitted with a 65mm rubber-tired wheel for immediate use.
Geared DC Motor: An internal gearbox lowers output speed and increases torque compared to a bare motor shaft.
Wide Voltage Range: Runs smoothly between 3V and 6V, matching common 2xAA to 4xAA battery packs.
Simple 2-Wire Control: Two motor leads connect directly to any H-bridge driver such as the L298N.
Lightweight Housing: Yellow plastic gearbox keeps the assembly light for small two-wheel-drive chassis.
Sold as a matched pair, this set is ideal for building two-wheel-drive robot cars, line followers, and obstacle-avoidance bots alongside a compatible motor driver and chassis.

name: LCD2004 20×4 Character LCD Display Module (Blue Backlight)

blocks.text: The LCD2004 20×4 Character LCD Display Module is a widely used alphanumeric display built around the industry-standard HD44780 controller, capable of showing 20 characters across 4 lines. Its crisp white-on-blue display and simple parallel interface make it a dependable choice for menus, sensor readouts, and status screens in Arduino and embedded projects.
Key features:
HD44780 Controller: Industry-standard driver chip supported by nearly every microcontroller LCD library.
20×4 Character Grid: Displays up to 80 characters at once across four rows of twenty.
Blue Backlight: White characters on a blue background with an onboard potentiometer for contrast adjustment.
Standard 16-Pin Interface: Works in 4-bit or 8-bit parallel mode, and accepts an I2C backpack for a 2-wire connection.
Wide Compatibility: Drop-in support for Arduino, STM32, Raspberry Pi, and other common microcontroller platforms.
This display suits data loggers, weather stations, menu-driven devices, and any project that has outgrown a smaller 16×2 screen.

name: TCRT5000L Infrared Reflective Optical Sensor

blocks.text: The TCRT5000L Infrared Reflective Optical Sensor is a leaded component combining an infrared emitter and a phototransistor in a single package, detecting nearby objects by sensing the IR light they reflect back. It’s widely used in line-following robots, object-counting systems and proximity-detection projects.
Key features:
Detection Type: Reflective infrared sensing using an integrated emitter and phototransistor pair.
Daylight Blocking Filter: Built-in filter reduces interference from ambient visible light.
Detection Range: Effective sensing distance of roughly 0.2mm to 15mm.
Compact Leaded Package: Snap-in mounting clips simplify placement on a PCB.
Fast Response: Microsecond-range switching time suits line-tracking and speed-sensitive applications.
Wide Compatibility: Pairs easily with comparator modules such as the LM393 for digital output.
It’s a low-cost building block for line-following robots, tachometers and simple object-presence detection.

name: PL2303 USB to TTL Serial Converter Module

blocks.text: The PL2303 USB to TTL Serial Converter Module is a compact USB-to-UART adapter built around Prolific’s PL2303 bridge chip, letting you connect serial TTL-level devices to a computer’s USB port for programming, debugging and communication. It’s a handy tool for flashing firmware and talking to microcontrollers and GPS or Bluetooth modules.
Key Features
Bridge Chip: Built around the Prolific PL2303 USB-to-serial bridge chip for wide driver support.
Dual Voltage Output: Selectable 3.3V or 5V logic levels for compatibility with a wide range of modules.
Standard Pinout: Breaks out TXD, RXD, GND, VCC and DTR on a 6-pin header.
Plug and Play: Connects via a standard USB-A port and enumerates as a virtual COM port.
LED Indicators: Onboard TX/RX LEDs give visual feedback of data activity.
Package Includes
1 x PL2303 USB to TTL Converter Module

name: 3S 40A Lithium Battery BMS Protection Board (Enhanced)

blocks.text: The 3S 40A Lithium Battery BMS Protection Board (Enhanced) is a battery management circuit built for three-cell (3S) lithium-ion or LiFePO4 packs, guarding against overcharge, over-discharge and short-circuit conditions during everyday use. Its enhanced design supports higher continuous current for e-bikes, power tools and DIY battery packs.
Key features:
Cell Configuration: Designed for 3S lithium battery packs with an 11.1V to 12.6V nominal range.
Continuous Current: Rated for up to 40A of continuous charge and discharge current.
Overcharge & Overdischarge Protection: Automatically disconnects the pack when any cell voltage goes out of range.
Short-Circuit & Overcurrent Protection: Instantly cuts power if a fault is detected on the output.
Cell Balancing: Helps keep individual cell voltages even while charging.
Low Standby Consumption: Minimal quiescent current preserves battery charge when idle.
It’s a compact, reliable safety layer for 3S packs built from 18650 or similar lithium cells.

name: PAM8403 Digital Audio Amplifier Module

blocks.text: The PAM8403 Digital Audio Amplifier Module is a tiny, efficient class-D stereo amplifier board built around the PAM8403 IC, delivering 2 x 3W of audio output from a low-voltage DC supply. It’s a popular choice for powering small speakers in portable audio projects and Arduino-based sound systems.
Key features:
Amplifier IC: Built around the PAM8403 dual-channel class-D audio amplifier chip.
Output Power: Delivers 2 x 3W of stereo output into 4Ω speakers.
Supply Voltage: Operates from 2.5V to 5V DC, making it easy to power from USB or batteries.
High Efficiency: Class-D switching design keeps heat low without needing a heatsink.
Compact Size: Its tiny footprint fits easily into small enclosures and portable builds.
Low Noise Output: Filterless design with low total harmonic distortion for clean sound.
Simply feed it a stereo line-level input and connect two small speakers to get instant amplified audio.

name: 4S 40A Lithium Battery BMS Protection Board (Balance Charging)

blocks.text: The 4S 40A Lithium Battery BMS Protection Board (Balance Charging) is a battery management circuit designed to protect four-cell (4S) lithium-ion or LiFePO4 packs from common failure conditions while balancing charge across the cells during use. It suits DIY power banks, e-bike packs and portable tool battery packs.
Key features:
Cell Configuration: Designed for 4S lithium battery packs at a 14.8V nominal pack voltage.
Continuous Current: Rated for up to 40A of continuous charge and discharge current.
Overcharge & Overdischarge Protection: Automatically disconnects the pack when any cell exceeds safe voltage limits.
Cell Balancing: Built-in balancing circuitry helps equalize voltage across all four cells during charging.
Short-Circuit Protection: Cuts power instantly if a short circuit is detected on the output.
Compact PCB: Small footprint fits easily inside battery packs and enclosures.
It’s a practical safety layer for any 4S lithium pack built from 18650 or similar cells.

name: MG90S Micro Servo Motor 180° (Metal Gear)

blocks.text: The MG90S Micro Servo Motor 180° (Metal Gear) is a compact, high-torque positional servo built around a durable all-metal gear train, delivering smooth and repeatable rotation for lightweight robotics and RC applications. Its small footprint makes it a popular metal-gear upgrade over plastic-gear micro servos.
Key features:
Metal Gear Train: Full metal gears replace the plastic gears found in standard micro servos, improving durability.
Rotation Angle: Delivers precise positional control across a 180° range of motion.
Stall Torque: Provides 2.2 kg.cm of torque at 4.8V for lifting light loads and mechanisms.
Operating Voltage: Runs on 4.8V to 6V, compatible with standard RC and microcontroller power rails.
Operating Speed: Moves at 0.1 s/60° at 4.8V for responsive positioning.
Standard PWM Control: Accepts a standard servo PWM signal, compatible with Arduino, Raspberry Pi and RC receivers.
It ships ready to mount, with a set of servo horns included for attaching arms and linkages to your project.

name: A4988 Stepper Motor Driver Module with Heatsink

blocks.text: The A4988 Stepper Motor Driver Module with Heatsink is a compact microstepping driver breakout board built around Allegro’s A4988 DMOS IC, letting you control bipolar stepper motors using just two logic pins. It handles current regulation, step translation and thermal protection on-chip for hassle-free integration.
Key features:
Driver IC: Built around the Allegro A4988 DMOS microstepping driver with a built-in translator.
Microstep Resolutions: Supports full, half, quarter, eighth and sixteenth step modes for smoother motion.
Current Limiting: Onboard trimmer potentiometer sets the maximum motor current to protect your stepper.
Onboard Heatsink: Pre-installed heatsink helps dissipate heat during sustained high-current operation.
Built-In Protection: Includes thermal shutdown and crossover-current protection for reliability.
Simple Interface: Needs only STEP and DIR signals from a microcontroller such as Arduino.
It’s a drop-in replacement for Pololu-style stepper driver sockets found on RAMPS, CNC shields and many 3D printer controller boards.

name: Dual-Axis XY Joystick Module (PS2-Style, with Push Button)

blocks.text: وحدة تحكم Joystick ثنائية المحور XY مع زر ضغط (PS2-Style)
الوصف بالعربي
وحدة Dual-Axis XY Joystick هي وحدة تحكم إلكترونية تعمل بعصا تحكم ثنائية المحور، تتيح التحكم في الاتجاهات والحركة على المحورين X وY، بالإضافة إلى زر ضغط مدمج يمكن استخدامه كمدخل إضافي للتحكم.

تعتمد الوحدة على مقاومتي جهد متغيرتين لتحديد موضع عصا التحكم، حيث توفر إشارات تناظرية يمكن قراءتها بسهولة باستخدام لوحات Arduino وESP32 وESP8266. كما يمكن استخدام زر الضغط لتنفيذ أوامر إضافية، مما يجعلها مناسبة لمشروعات الروبوتات والألعاب وأنظمة التحكم عن بُعد.
المميزات
تحكم ثنائي المحور X وY.
زر ضغط مدمج لتنفيذ أوامر إضافية.
خرج تناظري لكل محور.
خرج رقمي لزر الضغط.
تصميم مدمج وسهل التوصيل.
متوافقة مع Arduino وESP32 وESP8266 مع مراعاة توافق الجهد.
التطبيقات
التحكم في حركة الروبوتات والسيارات الذكية.
مشروعات الألعاب والتحكم اليدوي.
التحكم في السيرفو والمحركات.
أنظمة التحكم عن بُعد.
المشروعات التعليمية والإلكترونية.
أطراف التوصيل (Pinout)
GND: الأرضي.
+5V / VCC: مصدر التغذية المناسب للوحدة.
VRx: خرج تناظري للمحور X.
VRy: خرج تناظري للمحور Y.
SW: خرج زر الضغط الرقمي.
قد تختلف أسماء الأطراف وترتيبها حسب إصدار الوحدة.
English Description

The Dual-Axis XY Joystick Module is a PS2-style control module featuring two-axis movement and an integrated push button. It uses potentiometers to generate analog signals corresponding to the joystick’s X and Y positions, while the push button provides an additional digital input.
The module is easy to integrate with Arduino, ESP32, and ESP8266 projects, subject to voltage compatibility, making it ideal for robotics, gaming, and manual control applications.
Features
Two-axis control: X and Y.
Built-in push button.
Analog outputs for both axes.
Digital output for the push button.
Compact design and easy integration.
Compatible with popular microcontroller boards.
Applications
Robot and smart car control.
Gaming and interactive projects.
Servo and motor control.
Remote control systems.
Educational electronics projects.
Pinout
GND: Ground.
VCC: Power supply.
VRx: Analog X-axis output.
VRy: Analog Y-axis output.
SW: Digital push-button output.
Note: Pin labels and supply voltage may vary by module version. Check the module pinout before connecting it to your controller.

name: 150W DC-DC Step-Up Boost Converter Module (10-32V to 12-35V)

blocks.text: The 150W DC-DC Step-Up Boost Converter Module takes a lower DC input and boosts it to a higher, adjustable output voltage, delivering up to 150W through a pair of finned aluminum heatsinks and a large toroidal inductor. It’s built for automotive and battery-boost applications that need more headroom than a typical small buck-boost module.
Key features:
Wide Input Range: Accepts 10V to 32V DC input, suitable for 12V and 24V battery systems.
Adjustable Output: Output voltage is continuously adjustable from 12V to 35V DC via an onboard potentiometer.
High Power Handling: Delivers up to 150W and 6A of continuous output current.
Dual Heatsinks: Large finned aluminum heatsinks keep the power MOSFETs cool under sustained load.
Screw Terminal Connections: Input and output screw terminals make wiring quick and secure without soldering.
High Efficiency: Reaches up to 94% conversion efficiency depending on the input/output voltage difference.
It’s commonly used to boost a 12V car battery up to 19V for powering a laptop, or to step up battery voltage for LED lighting and other higher-voltage electronics.

name: MG995 180° Analog Servo Motor (Half Metal Gear)

blocks.text: The MG995 180° Analog Servo Motor is a high-torque hobby servo with a half-metal gear train, designed for RC models, robotic arms, and pan-tilt mechanisms that need reliable positioning under load. It rotates across a 180° range and is controlled with a standard PWM signal.
Key features:
High Torque Output: Delivers 10 kg.cm of torque at 4.8V and up to 12 kg.cm at 6V, enough for demanding RC and robotics loads.
Half-Metal Gear Train: Combines metal and plastic gears for improved durability over fully plastic-geared servos at a lower cost than full-metal versions.
Standard PWM Control: Accepts a standard analog servo pulse signal compatible with Arduino, RC receivers, and servo controllers.
Wide Voltage Range: Operates from 4.8V to 7.2V, allowing use with common RC battery packs.
Dual Ball Bearings: Support the output shaft for smoother rotation and reduced wobble under load.
Universal Mounting Tabs: Standard servo horn and mounting hole pattern fit most RC and robotics hardware.
It’s a solid mid-range choice when a project needs more muscle than a micro servo but doesn’t require a fully metal-geared unit.

name: TSOP1838 (JS-1838B) 3-Pin Infrared Remote Receiver

blocks.text: The TSOP1838 (JS-1838B) Infrared Remote Receiver is a 3-pin IR demodulator module designed to detect and decode signals from standard 38kHz infrared remote controls. It combines a PIN photodiode and preamplifier in a single TO-92 package for reliable remote-control sensing.
Key features:
38kHz Carrier Detection: Tuned to demodulate the 38kHz carrier frequency used by most consumer IR remotes.
Digital Output: Delivers an active-low logic-level output that can be read directly by a microcontroller pin.
Long Reception Range: Detects signals from several meters away under normal ambient light.
Built-In Noise Filtering: Internal circuitry rejects ambient light and electrical noise for cleaner decoding.
Simple 3-Pin Wiring: OUT, GND, and VCC pins connect directly to Arduino, ESP32, or other microcontroller boards.
Low Power Consumption: Draws minimal current, suitable for battery-powered remote-control receivers.
It’s a go-to component for building universal remotes, IR-controlled robots, and home automation projects that need to recognize standard remote-control signals.

name: DS18B20 Digital Temperature Sensor (TO-92)

blocks.text: The DS18B20 Digital Temperature Sensor is a 1-Wire digital sensor housed in a compact TO-92 package, delivering 9 to 12-bit temperature readings directly over a single data line. Each sensor carries a unique 64-bit serial code, so multiple DS18B20 sensors can share the same data bus.
Key features:
1-Wire Digital Interface: Communicates temperature data over a single data pin, reducing wiring compared to analog sensors.
Wide Temperature Range: Measures from -55°C to +125°C, with ±0.5°C accuracy from -10°C to +85°C.
Configurable Resolution: User-selectable resolution from 9 to 12 bits (0.5°C down to 0.0625°C).
Unique Serial ID: Each chip has a factory-programmed 64-bit address, allowing many sensors to share one bus.
Parasite Power Mode: Can draw power directly from the data line, removing the need for a separate power wire in some setups.
Compact TO-92 Package: Standard 3-pin transistor-style package for easy breadboarding.
It’s a popular choice for weather stations, 3D printer hotends, and multi-point temperature logging projects.

name: LM35 Precision Centigrade Temperature Sensor IC (TO-92)

blocks.text: The LM35 Precision Centigrade Temperature Sensor IC is a 3-pin analog sensor housed in a TO-92 package that outputs a voltage linearly proportional to the temperature in Celsius. Unlike thermistor-based sensors, it needs no external calibration or lookup tables to get an accurate reading.
Key features:
Linear Analog Output: Produces 10mV per degree Celsius, so the reading converts to temperature with simple math on any microcontroller’s ADC.
Factory Calibrated: Calibrated directly in degrees Celsius, eliminating the need for external calibration or trimming.
Wide Sensing Range: Measures temperatures from 0°C to +100°C (LM35DZ variant).
Low Self-Heating: Draws under 60µA of supply current, keeping self-heating below 0.1°C in still air.
Wide Supply Range: Operates from a single 4V to 30V supply, compatible with most microcontroller boards.
Simple 3-Pin Package: TO-92 package with VCC, VOUT, and GND pins for easy breadboard or perfboard mounting.
It’s a straightforward, low-cost option for temperature monitoring, incubators, and weather stations where fast analog readings matter more than the extended range of a digital sensor.

name: 65-Piece Solderless Breadboard Jumper Wire Kit (Male-to-Male)

blocks.text: The 65-Piece Solderless Breadboard Jumper Wire Kit is a bundle of ready-to-use male-to-male jumper wires for prototyping on a solderless breadboard. Each wire has a rigid pin on both ends, so it plugs straight into breadboard rows and columns without any soldering or stripping.
Key Features
Quantity: 65 individual jumper wires in assorted colors for easy circuit tracing.
Male-to-Male Ends: Solid pin connectors on both ends plug directly into breadboards, headers, and 2.54mm pitch sockets.
Assorted Lengths: Multiple lengths let you route connections neatly across large or small breadboard layouts.
Flexible Wire: Soft, bendable insulation makes routing around components simple.
No Soldering Required: Fully solderless and ready to use straight out of the pack.
Package Includes
65 x Male-to-Male Jumper Wires (assorted colors and lengths)

name: DS1302 Real-Time Clock (RTC) Module with Battery

blocks.text: The DS1302 Real-Time Clock (RTC) Module is a compact timekeeping board built around the DS1302 trickle-charge clock chip, paired with a CR2032 coin-cell battery holder so it keeps running even when the main power is disconnected. It tracks seconds, minutes, hours, day, date, month, and year with automatic leap-year compensation.
Key features:
DS1302 Clock Chip: A low-power trickle-charge timekeeping chip that communicates over a simple 3-wire serial interface (CE, I/O, SCLK).
Backup Battery: Includes a CR2032 3V lithium coin-cell holder so the clock keeps time during power loss or reprogramming.
Full Calendar Tracking: Provides seconds, minutes, hours, day of week, date, month, and year, with automatic adjustment for short months and leap years.
12/24-Hour Modes: Supports both 12-hour (with AM/PM flag) and 24-hour time formats.
Onboard RAM: Features 31 bytes of battery-backed static RAM for storing small amounts of user data.
Easy Integration: Simple pin headers (VCC, GND, CLK, DAT, RST) wire directly to Arduino, ESP32, or other microcontrollers.
It’s a low-cost way to add accurate date and time tracking to data loggers, alarm clocks, and other projects that need to remember the time between power cycles.

name: AC 220V 2000W SCR Voltage Regulator Dimmer Module

blocks.text: The AC 220V 2000W SCR Voltage Regulator Dimmer Module is a phase-angle control board that adjusts AC output voltage to control the speed, brightness, or heat output of connected loads. Built around a thyristor (SCR) and a front-panel potentiometer, it handles loads up to 2000W directly from mains power.
Key features:
2000W Load Capacity: Rated to control AC loads up to 2000W directly from a 220V mains supply.
Phase-Angle SCR Control: Uses thyristor-based phase control for smooth, stepless voltage adjustment.
Multi-Purpose: Suitable for motor speed control, incandescent light dimming, and heater/thermostat regulation.
Manual Potentiometer Knob: Front-mounted knob provides simple, tool-free adjustment of output power.
Aluminum Heatsink: Onboard heatsink keeps the SCR cool under sustained high-power loads.
Screw Terminal Connections: Input and output wiring connect via secure screw terminals.
This module carries mains voltage on exposed terminals, so it should always be installed inside an enclosure with standard electrical safety precautions.

name: SOIC8/SOP8 Test Clip with CH341A Adapter Boards

blocks.text: The SOIC8/SOP8 Test Clip with CH341A Adapter Boards is a solderless in-circuit programming accessory that clips directly onto an 8-pin SOIC/SOP flash or EEPROM chip. It comes bundled with two small adapter boards, letting the clip connect to a CH341A or similar USB programmer without desoldering the target chip.
Key Features
Solderless Connection: Spring-loaded clip grips directly onto an SOIC8/SOP8 chip for in-circuit reading and writing.
Two Adapter Boards: Includes breakout boards that interface the clip cable with standard programmer headers.
Ribbon Cable: Flexible multi-conductor cable keeps the clip maneuverable around crowded boards.
Pin 1 Marking: Clip and adapter boards are marked to keep chip orientation correct during programming.
Wide Compatibility: Works with CH341A, TL866, and other common 24xx/25xx series EEPROM and BIOS programmers.
Package Includes
1 x SOIC8/SOP8 Test Clip with Ribbon Cable
2 x Adapter Boards

name: 12V DC Brushless Water Pump (MF11)

blocks.text: The 12V DC Brushless Water Pump (MF11) is a compact, fully submersible pump designed for continuous circulation in fountains, aquariums, cooling loops, and hobbyist fluid projects. Its brushless motor runs quietly and efficiently, drawing power directly from a 12V DC source without the wear of brushed motors.
Key features:
Brushless DC Motor: Delivers quiet, long-lasting operation without the sparking and wear of brushed motor pumps.
12V DC Operation: Runs directly from a standard 12V power supply or battery, drawing around 4.8W.
300 L/H Flow Rate: Provides steady circulation suitable for small fountains, cooling systems, and aquariums.
Fully Submersible (IP68): Sealed housing allows continuous underwater operation without leaks.
Compact Housing: Small footprint with a mounting bracket for easy installation in tanks or reservoirs.
Barbed Outlet Fitting: Accepts standard flexible tubing for simple plumbing into a project.

name: LCD2002 20×2 Character LCD Display (Blue Backlight)

blocks.text: The LCD2002 20×2 Character LCD Display (Blue Backlight) is a HD44780-compatible alphanumeric screen that shows 20 characters across 2 lines, offering more horizontal space than a standard 16×2 module for longer labels and readings. It uses a blue background with crisp white text for clear visibility in typical indoor lighting.
Key features:
20×2 Character Display: Shows two lines of 20 characters each, useful for longer labels, units, or multi-value readouts.
HD44780-Compatible Controller: Works with the widely supported HD44780 command set and standard Arduino LCD libraries.
Blue Backlight: High-contrast white-on-blue display for clear visibility in normal lighting.
Parallel Interface: Connects via an 8-bit or 4-bit parallel interface using the standard 16-pin header.
I2C Adapter Compatible: Can be paired with a separate I2C backpack to cut down the pin count needed from a microcontroller.
Wide Operating Voltage: Runs on a standard 5V supply, compatible with Arduino and similar 5V logic boards.
Its wider single-line format suits readouts with longer text than a 16-column display can comfortably show.

name: LCD1604 16×4 Character LCD Display (Blue Backlight)

blocks.text: The LCD1604 16×4 Character LCD Display (Blue Backlight) is a HD44780-compatible alphanumeric screen that shows 16 characters across 4 lines, giving twice the display area of a standard 16×2 module. It uses a blue background with crisp white text, making it easy to read menus, sensor readings, and status messages.
Key features:
16×4 Character Display: Shows four lines of 16 characters each, ideal for menus, logs, or multi-line sensor readouts.
HD44780-Compatible Controller: Works with the widely supported HD44780 command set and standard Arduino LCD libraries.
Blue Backlight: High-contrast white-on-blue display for clear visibility in normal lighting.
Parallel Interface: Connects via an 8-bit or 4-bit parallel interface using the standard 16-pin header.
I2C Adapter Compatible: Can be paired with a separate I2C backpack to reduce the pin count needed from a microcontroller.
Wide Operating Voltage: Runs on a standard 5V supply, compatible with Arduino and similar 5V logic boards.
This module is a drop-in upgrade path for projects that have outgrown a 16×2 screen and need more on-screen text.

name: ESP8266-12F (ESP-12F) WiFi Serial Module

blocks.text: The ESP8266-12F (ESP-12F) WiFi Serial Module is a surface-mount module built around the ESP8266 Wi-Fi SoC, offering a compact and reliable way to add wireless connectivity to embedded projects. It exposes the microcontroller’s GPIO, UART, and ADC pins on a standard castellated edge for easy mounting onto a carrier board.
Key Features
Wi-Fi Chipset: ESP8266 with an integrated TCP/IP stack and 802.11 b/g/n connectivity.
Flash Memory: 4MB of onboard flash for firmware and application storage.
Low Power Design: Operates at 3.3V with deep-sleep modes for battery-powered applications.
Compact Footprint: Small SMD module easily integrates onto custom carrier boards and shields.
Onboard PCB Antenna: Printed trace antenna keeps the module low-profile without an external connector.
Package Includes
1 x ESP8266-12F (ESP-12F) WiFi Module

name: BMP180 GY-68 Barometric Pressure Sensor Module

blocks.text: The BMP180 GY-68 Barometric Pressure Sensor Module is a breakout board built around Bosch’s BMP180 digital barometric pressure sensor, delivering precise pressure and temperature readings for altitude sensing, weather stations, and GPS enhancement. Its small footprint and low power draw make it easy to add to any microcontroller-based project.
Key features:
High Precision: Measures absolute pressure with a resolution down to 0.03 hPa, equivalent to about 25cm of altitude change.
Wide Pressure Range: Operates from 300 hPa to 1100 hPa, covering altitudes from -500m to +9000m.
I2C Interface: Communicates over the standard two-wire I2C bus for easy connection to Arduino, ESP8266, and similar boards.
Integrated Temperature Sensing: Provides temperature-compensated readings alongside pressure data.
Low Power Consumption: Ultra-low power design suits battery-powered weather and altitude-tracking projects.
Onboard Voltage Regulation: Accepts 3.3V to 5V input despite the BMP180 chip’s native 1.8V to 3.6V logic.

name: GY-521 MPU6050 6-Axis Gyroscope Accelerometer Module

blocks.text: وحدة قياس الحركة GY-521 MPU6050 6-Axis Gyroscope & Accelerometer Module
الوصف بالعربي

وحدة GY-521 MPU6050 هي وحدة استشعار للحركة والاتجاه، تجمع بين جيروسكوب ثلاثي المحاور (3-Axis Gyroscope) ومقياس تسارع ثلاثي المحاور (3-Axis Accelerometer) في وحدة واحدة، مما يتيح قياس الحركة والتسارع ومعدل الدوران في الاتجاهات الثلاثة.

تعتمد الوحدة على شريحة MPU6050 وتدعم الاتصال عبر بروتوكول I2C، مما يجعل توصيلها سهلًا مع لوحات Arduino وESP32 وESP8266. تُستخدم على نطاق واسع في مشروعات الروبوتات والطائرات بدون طيار وأنظمة التوازن وتتبع الحركة.
المميزات
مستشعر حركة سداسي المحاور (6-Axis).
جيروسكوب لقياس معدل الدوران على المحاور X وY وZ.
مقياس تسارع لقياس التسارع والحركة في ثلاثة محاور.
يدعم الاتصال عبر I2C.
مناسب لمشروعات Arduino وESP32 وESP8266.
حجم صغير وسهل الدمج في المشروعات الإلكترونية.
التطبيقات
الروبوتات وأنظمة التوازن الذاتي.
الطائرات بدون طيار (Drones).
قياس الميل والحركة والاهتزاز.
وحدات التحكم في الألعاب والحركة.
مشروعات إنترنت الأشياء والإلكترونيات التعليمية.
المواصفات الفنية
اسم الوحدة: GY-521.
الشريحة: MPU6050.
نوع المستشعر: Accelerometer + Gyroscope.
عدد المحاور: 6 محاور.
واجهة الاتصال: I2C.
أطراف الاتصال الأساسية: VCC، GND، SCL، SDA.
أطراف إضافية: قد تشمل INT وAD0 وXDA وXCL حسب إصدار الوحدة.
التوصيل
VCC: مصدر التغذية المناسب للوحدة.
GND: الأرضي.
SCL: خط الساعة لاتصال I2C.
SDA: خط البيانات لاتصال I2C.
ملاحظة: تختلف خصائص التغذية حسب تصميم لوحة GY-521. يجب التأكد من جهد التشغيل المناسب قبل التوصيل، خاصة عند استخدام لوحات ESP32 أو ESP8266.
English Description

The GY-521 MPU6050 is a 6-axis motion sensor module that combines a 3-axis gyroscope and a 3-axis accelerometer in a single package. It measures angular velocity and acceleration along the X, Y, and Z axes, making it suitable for motion tracking and orientation-related projects.
The module communicates through the I2C interface and can be integrated with Arduino, ESP32, and ESP8266 boards.
Features
6-axis motion sensing.

name: MQ-8 Hydrogen Gas Sensor Module

blocks.text: The MQ-8 Hydrogen Gas Sensor Module uses a tin dioxide (SnO2) sensing element to detect hydrogen gas concentrations in the surrounding air. As hydrogen levels rise, the sensor’s conductivity increases, producing an analog output voltage that a microcontroller can read directly.
Key features:
Hydrogen-Specific Sensing: Detects hydrogen gas concentrations from about 100 to 10,000 ppm.
Built-In Heater Element: An internal heater maintains the ideal operating temperature for stable readings.
Analog Output: Provides a voltage output proportional to gas concentration for easy analog-to-digital conversion.
Fast Response Time: Reacts quickly to changes in hydrogen concentration once warmed up.
Simple Pin Interface: Connects with just VCC, GND, and an analog output pin.
It is well suited to hydrogen leak detection, fuel cell monitoring, and general gas-safety projects with Arduino or similar microcontrollers.

name: 140-Piece Breadboard Jumper Wire Kit (Assorted Lengths)

blocks.text: The 140-Piece Breadboard Jumper Wire Kit is a boxed assortment of pre-formed, pre-stripped solid-core wires for quickly building circuits on a solderless breadboard. It replaces a tangle of loose jumpers with 14 fixed lengths sorted neatly into a reusable storage case.
Key Features
Assorted Lengths: 14 different lengths from 2mm up to 125mm, 10 pieces of each, covering most breadboard layouts.
Pre-Formed Ends: Each wire is bent and stripped for a clean, flush fit into breadboard holes.
22AWG Solid Core: Rigid wire holds its shape and makes reliable contact in breadboard sockets.
Color-Coded: Multiple wire colors make it easy to trace signal, power, and ground connections.
Reusable Storage Case: A compartmentalized plastic box keeps every length sorted and easy to find.
Package Includes
140 x Assorted Jumper Wires
1 x Storage Case

name: Micro SD Card Reader Module (SPI)

blocks.text: The Micro SD Card Reader Module is an SPI breakout board that lets Arduino, ESP8266, and other microcontrollers read and write files on a standard microSD card. An onboard 3.3V regulator and built-in level shifting let it connect directly to 5V logic boards without extra components.
Key features:
SPI Interface: Communicates over standard SPI (CS, SCK, MOSI, MISO), compatible with the popular SD library.
Onboard Voltage Regulation: An AMS1117 LDO regulator steps the supply down to the 3.3V a microSD card needs.
Logic Level Shifting: Built-in level shifting allows safe operation with both 3.3V and 5V microcontrollers.
Spring-Loaded Card Slot: A push-push microSD socket holds the card securely during use.
Compact Breakout: A small 6-pin header footprint fits easily on a breadboard or perfboard.
It is commonly used for data logging, MP3 playback, and file storage in Arduino and Raspberry Pi projects.

name: NRF24L01 3.3V Power Adapter Board

blocks.text: The NRF24L01 3.3V Power Adapter Board is a small breakout that lets a standard NRF24L01 wireless module plug directly into 5V microcontroller boards such as the Arduino Uno without a separate regulator or extra wiring. It steps 5V down to a clean 3.3V supply while passing the SPI signals straight through to its eight-pin socket.
Key features:
Onboard Voltage Regulation: Converts a 5V supply to the stable 3.3V that NRF24L01 modules require.
Direct Socket Mount: An 8-pin female header lets the NRF24L01 module plug straight in, no soldering needed.
Reduces Wiring Errors: Passes through MISO, MOSI, SCK, CSN, CE, and IRQ pins in the correct order for common Arduino wiring.
Compact Design: Small enough to fit on a breadboard alongside the host microcontroller.
Improves Signal Stability: A cleaner power supply reduces the packet loss common when powering NRF24L01 modules directly from a 3.3V pin.
It is a handy accessory for anyone building NRF24L01-based wireless projects on 5V boards like the Arduino Uno or Mega.

name: HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Distance Sensor Module

blocks.text: The HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Distance Sensor Module measures distance by emitting a burst of 40kHz ultrasonic pulses and timing the echo that bounces back from nearby objects. Its twin-transducer design separates the transmitter and receiver, giving accurate, non-contact distance readings from 2cm out to 4 meters.
Key features:
Non-Contact Ranging: Measures distance from 2cm to 400cm using ultrasonic time-of-flight, with roughly 3mm accuracy.
Simple Trigger/Echo Interface: A 10-microsecond trigger pulse starts a measurement, and the echo pin returns a pulse proportional to distance.
Wide Measuring Angle: Effective detection angle of about 15 degrees in front of the sensor.
5V Logic Compatible: Works directly with 5V microcontrollers such as Arduino without level shifting.
Low Current Draw: Draws around 15mA during operation, well suited to battery-powered projects.
It is one of the most widely used sensors in robotics for obstacle avoidance, parking assistants, and liquid-level measurement projects.

name: HC-SR501 Adjustable PIR Motion Sensor Module

blocks.text: The HC-SR501 Adjustable PIR Motion Sensor Module is a passive infrared detector that senses the body heat of people and animals moving within its field of view. Built around the BISS0001 control IC and a pyroelectric sensor beneath a Fresnel lens dome, it outputs a simple digital signal whenever motion is detected.
Key features:
Pyroelectric Detection: Uses a Fresnel lens dome to focus infrared changes onto the sensor for reliable motion sensing.
Adjustable Sensitivity: An onboard potentiometer sets the detection distance up to roughly 7 meters.
Adjustable Delay Time: A second potentiometer sets how long the output stays high after motion stops, from about 5 seconds to 5 minutes.
Trigger Mode Jumper: Selectable single-trigger or repeatable-trigger operation via an onboard jumper.
Wide Input Voltage: Operates from 4.5V to 20V DC, with a 3.3V logic-level digital output.
Low Power Consumption: Draws under 65 microamps in standby, suitable for battery-powered projects.
It is widely used in automatic lighting, security alarms, and occupancy-sensing projects with Arduino, ESP8266, and Raspberry Pi.

name: VHM-314 Bluetooth 5.0 Stereo Audio Receiver Module

blocks.text: The VHM-314 Bluetooth 5.0 Stereo Audio Receiver Module is a compact wireless audio board that adds Bluetooth streaming to any wired speaker, amplifier, or headphone setup. Built around a dedicated Bluetooth decoder chip, it pairs quickly with phones and other source devices and outputs clean stereo sound through its onboard 3.5mm jack.
Key features:
Bluetooth 5.0 Chipset: Delivers a stable wireless link with lower latency and better range than older Bluetooth versions.
Stereo 3.5mm Output: Onboard headphone jack connects directly to speakers, amplifiers, or powered monitors.
Micro USB Power: Runs from any 3.7V to 5V USB power source, ideal for battery packs or wall adapters.
LED Pairing Indicator: Onboard LED shows connection and pairing status at a glance.
Compact Footprint: Roughly 30mm x 30mm, small enough to embed inside existing speaker enclosures.
It is a popular choice for retrofitting older wired speakers with modern Bluetooth streaming, needing only a power source and a connection to the existing audio input.

name: Arduino UNO R4 WiFi Development Board with USB Cable

blocks.text: The Arduino UNO R4 WiFi Development Board is the latest evolution of the classic Arduino Uno, pairing a 32-bit Renesas RA4M1 processor with an onboard ESP32-S3 module for built-in WiFi and Bluetooth. It keeps the familiar Uno pinout while adding a 12×8 LED matrix, USB-C port, and DAC for more capable projects.
Key Features
Microcontroller: Renesas RA4M1 (Arm Cortex-M4) with an onboard ESP32-S3 co-processor for wireless connectivity.
Wireless Connectivity: Built-in 2.4GHz WiFi and Bluetooth 5.0 via the onboard ESP32-S3 module.
USB-C Programming Port: Modern USB-C connector for programming and power, replacing the older USB-B.
Built-in LED Matrix: A 12×8 addressable LED matrix for simple visual feedback without extra wiring.
Classic Uno Pinout: Fully compatible with existing Uno shields, with 14 digital I/O pins and 6 analog inputs.
Onboard DAC: A 12-bit digital-to-analog converter for smoother analog signal generation.
Package Includes
1 x Arduino UNO R4 WiFi Board
1 x USB Cable

name: Arduino UNO R4 Minima Development Board (Clone) with Cable

blocks.text: The Arduino UNO R4 Minima Development Board (Clone) with Cable is a next-generation update to the classic Uno form factor, built around a 32-bit Renesas RA4M1 ARM Cortex-M4 microcontroller instead of the original ATmega328P. It keeps the familiar Uno pinout and shield compatibility while adding significantly more memory, speed, and a USB Type-C connector.
Key Features
Microcontroller: Renesas RA4M1, a 32-bit ARM Cortex-M4 core running at 48MHz.
Operating Voltage: 5V, with a recommended input voltage range of 6-24V through the DC jack.
Increased Memory: 256 KB of flash memory and 32 KB of SRAM, far more than the classic Uno.
USB Type-C Connectivity: Modern USB-C port for programming and power delivery.
Classic Uno Pinout: 14 digital I/O pins and 6 analog inputs, fully compatible with existing Uno shields.
Arduino IDE Compatible: Programs using the standard Arduino IDE, just like previous Uno boards.
Package Includes
1 x Arduino UNO R4 Minima Board
1 x USB Cable

name: Arduino Leonardo R3 Development Board with USB Cable

blocks.text: The Arduino Leonardo R3 Development Board with USB Cable is a microcontroller board built around the ATmega32U4, the first Arduino board with USB communication built directly into the chip instead of a secondary USB-to-serial converter. This lets it appear directly to a computer as a mouse, keyboard, or virtual serial port, making it ideal for HID and USB-interfacing projects.
Key Features
Microcontroller: ATmega32U4 running at 16MHz with native USB support built into the chip.
Operating Voltage: 5V, with a recommended input voltage range of 7-12V through the DC jack.
Enhanced Pinout: 20 digital I/O pins (7 of which support PWM) and 12 analog inputs.
Native USB HID: Can act as a USB keyboard, mouse, or joystick directly, without an external USB-to-serial converter.
Micro USB Connector: Compact Micro USB port for programming and power.
Arduino IDE Compatible: Fully supported by the Arduino IDE for straightforward coding and uploading.
Package Includes
1 x Arduino Leonardo R3 Board
1 x USB Cable

name: STM32F401CCU6 Development Board (Black Pill) with USB-C

blocks.text: The STM32F401CCU6 Development Board (Black Pill) with USB-C is a compact, breadboard-friendly ARM Cortex-M4 board built around STMicroelectronics’ STM32F401CCU6 microcontroller. It packs a floating-point unit and DSP instructions into a low-cost module, making it a popular upgrade path from 8-bit boards for makers who need more performance and memory.
Key Features
Microcontroller: STM32F401CCU6, an ARM Cortex-M4 core running at up to 84 MHz with a hardware floating-point unit.
Flash & RAM: 256 KB of flash memory and 64 KB of SRAM for larger sketches and data buffers.
USB Type-C: Onboard USB-C connector for programming, power, and USB device communication.
BOOT0/RESET Buttons: Dedicated buttons for entering bootloader mode and resetting the board without extra wiring.
Breadboard-Friendly Layout: Dual-row 0.1-inch pin headers bring out GPIO, SPI, I2C, and USART pins for easy prototyping.
Package Includes
1 x STM32F401CCU6 Black Pill Board
2 x Pin Header Strips

name: R307 Optical Fingerprint Sensor Module (UART)

blocks.text: The R307 Optical Fingerprint Sensor Module is a UART-based biometric sensor that captures, stores, and matches fingerprint images for secure access control and identity verification projects. Built around a high-precision optical scanner and a dedicated onboard DSP, it can enroll and compare fingerprints independently of a host microcontroller, making integration straightforward.
Key features:
Optical Fingerprint Sensing: Captures high-resolution fingerprint images using an integrated optical scanner and lens assembly.
Onboard Template Storage: Stores up to 1000 fingerprint templates directly in the module’s flash memory.
UART/USB Interface: Communicates with a host microcontroller over TTL serial (UART) at selectable baud rates, or via USB.
Fast Matching: Performs 1:1 and 1:N fingerprint matching in under a second for responsive access control.
Compact Embedded Module: Measures just 44.1 x 20 x 23.5mm, making it easy to embed in locks, safes, and attendance systems.
Wide Operating Voltage: Runs from 3.6V to 6.0V, compatible with common 5V microcontroller power rails.

name: 18650 Lithium Battery Charging Module with LED Digital Display 5V 2.4A

blocks.text: The 18650 Lithium Battery Charging Module with LED Digital Display 5V 2.4A is an all-in-one boost/charge board for building custom power banks from 18650 lithium cells. It charges the battery through its Micro USB or USB Type-C input while a built-in digital display shows charge status, and its dual USB outputs deliver regulated 5V power to connected devices.
Key features:
Digital Display: Onboard LED screen shows charge percentage and output status at a glance.
Dual Input Charging: Accepts Micro USB or USB Type-C input for charging the 18650 cell.
Dual USB Output: Two USB-A output ports supply up to 2.4A combined for charging phones and other devices.
Boost Converter: Steps up the battery voltage to a stable 5V output suitable for USB-powered electronics.
Protection Circuitry: Built-in overcharge and overdischarge protection safeguards the cell during use.
Compact PCB Design: Small footprint makes it easy to fit inside custom power bank enclosures.

name: Relay Module 1-Channel 5V Low Level Trigger

blocks.text: The Relay Module 1-Channel 5V Low Level Trigger is a compact interface board that lets a microcontroller such as an Arduino safely switch high-voltage or high-current loads. Built around a single SPDT relay rated for both AC and DC loads, it isolates the low-power control signal from the switched circuit, making it ideal for home automation and DIY switching projects.
Key features:
Low Level Trigger: Activates the relay when the IN pin is pulled LOW, matching the logic used by most microcontroller GPIO outputs.
High Current Rating: Switches loads up to 10A at 250VAC or 10A at 30VDC through the onboard relay.
Screw Terminal Block: Provides Normally Open (NO), Common (COM), and Normally Closed (NC) terminals for quick, secure wiring.
Status Indicator: An onboard LED lights up whenever the relay is energized, making the module state easy to check.
Flyback Protection: Includes a protection diode across the relay coil to suppress voltage spikes when switching off.
Simple 3-Pin Interface: Connects with just VCC, GND, and IN pins, compatible with 5V logic from Arduino and similar boards.

name: Arduino Nano V3.0 ATmega328P Development Board with USB Cable

blocks.text: The Arduino Nano V3.0 ATmega328P Development Board with USB Cable is a compact, breadboard-friendly board built around the ATmega328P microcontroller, offering the same functionality as the Arduino Uno in a much smaller footprint. It comes bundled with a Mini-USB cable so it is ready to program and power straight out of the box.
Key Features
Microcontroller: ATmega328P running at 16MHz for reliable performance.
Operating Voltage: 5V, powered directly through the Mini-USB port or an external 7-12V supply.
Compact Footprint: 14 digital I/O pins (6 PWM-capable) and 8 analog inputs packed into a breadboard-friendly board.
USB Connectivity: Mini-USB interface with an onboard USB-to-serial chip for easy programming from the Arduino IDE.
Beginner-Friendly: Well-documented pinout and huge community support make it ideal for learning and prototyping.
Package Includes
1 x Arduino Nano V3.0 Board
1 x Mini-USB Cable

name: R20D USB 125kHz Proximity Smart RFID ID Card Reader

blocks.text: The R20D USB 125kHz Proximity Smart RFID ID Card Reader is a driver-free desktop reader that scans 125kHz proximity cards and key fobs and outputs their ID number as if typed on a keyboard. It plugs directly into a PC’s USB port, making it a simple way to add card-based login or attendance logging to any Windows application.
Key features:
Driver-Free USB: Recognized as a standard USB HID keyboard device, with no drivers to install on Windows.
125kHz Read Range: Detects EM4100-compatible cards and fobs from up to 30mm away.
Fast Response: Reads and outputs a card ID in a fraction of a second at 106 Kbit/s.
Compact Desktop Form: Slim black enclosure sits neatly beside a keyboard or point-of-sale terminal.
Wide Compatibility: Works with any software that accepts keyboard input, from access control to attendance systems.

name: Handheld 125kHz RFID ID Card Copier / Writer Duplicator

blocks.text: The Handheld 125kHz RFID ID Card Copier / Writer Duplicator is a pocket-sized cloning tool that reads a 125kHz proximity card or key fob and writes its ID number onto a blank rewritable tag. It needs no software or PC connection, making it a quick way to duplicate access cards for gates, doors and time-attendance systems.
Key features:
Read and Write in One Step: Press READ to capture a card’s ID, then press WRITE to copy it onto a compatible blank tag.
125kHz Compatibility: Works with common EM4100 format cards and writes to rewritable T5577/EM4305 tags.
Standalone Operation: Fully self-contained with onboard LED status indicators, no computer or app required.
Bundled Blank Tags: Comes with rewritable key fobs and cards ready for immediate duplication.
Portable Design: Compact handheld shape fits in a pocket for on-site card cloning and access management.

name: 2WD Smart Robot Car Chassis Kit with TT Motors and Wheels (1-Layer)

blocks.text: The 2WD Smart Robot Car Chassis Kit with TT Motors and Wheels is a single-layer acrylic platform for building a two-wheel-drive robot from scratch. It ships with two yellow TT gear motors, two rubber-tyred wheels, a front caster wheel, a 4xAA battery holder and the screws needed for assembly, giving hobbyists a ready-made base for Arduino or Raspberry Pi robotics projects.
Key features:
Acrylic Chassis: Laser-cut single-layer platform with mounting holes for motor driver boards, sensors and microcontrollers.
Dual TT Gear Motors: Two 3V to 6V DC gear motors provide independent drive to the left and right wheels.
Rubber-Tyred Wheels: A matched pair of 65mm wheels grips smoothly on smooth and lightly textured surfaces.
Front Caster Wheel: A free-rolling ball caster supports the front of the chassis for stable, low-friction turning.
Battery Holder Included: A 4xAA battery box supplies power to the motors without extra wiring.

name: XL6009 DC-DC Step-Up Boost Converter Module (4A)

blocks.text: وحدة رفع الجهد XL6009 DC-DC Step-Up Boost Converter Module (4A)
الوصف بالعربي

وحدة XL6009 هي دائرة إلكترونية لرفع الجهد المستمر (DC-DC Boost Converter)، تُستخدم لتحويل جهد دخل منخفض إلى جهد خرج أعلى قابل للضبط. تعتمد على شريحة XL6009 وتتميز بكفاءة تحويل جيدة، مما يجعلها مناسبة للعديد من مشروعات الإلكترونيات والطاقة.
تحتوي الوحدة على مقاومة متغيرة لضبط جهد الخرج، ويمكن استخدامها في مشروعات Arduino والروبوتات وأنظمة البطاريات، بالإضافة إلى التطبيقات التي تحتاج إلى جهد أعلى من مصدر التغذية المتاح.

رفع جهد التيار المستمر DC إلى جهد أعلى.
جهد خرج قابل للضبط.

رفع جهد البطاريات.

نوع الوحدة: DC-DC Step-Up Boost Converter.

The XL6009 DC-DC Step-Up Boost Converter Module is a switching regulator designed to increase a lower DC input voltage to a higher adjustable output voltage. Based on the XL6009 boost converter IC, it offers good conversion efficiency and is suitable for a wide range of electronics and power supply projects.
The module features an adjustable potentiometer for setting the output voltage, making it useful for battery-powered applications, robotics, and DIY electronics.
Features
Boosts DC input voltage to a higher output voltage.
Adjustable output voltage.
Based on the XL6009 switching regulator IC.
Good conversion efficiency.
Compact design and easy installation.
Suitable for Arduino, ESP32, robotics, and DIY projects.
Applications
Battery voltage boosting.
Electronic circuit power supplies.
Arduino and ESP32 projects.
Robotics and IoT applications.
DIY power supply systems.
Technical Specifications
Module Type: DC-DC Step-Up Boost Converter.
Main IC: XL6009.
Output Voltage: Adjustable.
Advertised Maximum Current: Up to 4A, depending on operating conditions.
Conversion Type: DC Step-Up.

Note: This module only steps up voltage; the output voltage must be higher than the input voltage. The actual available output current depends on the voltage difference, cooling, and operating conditions. Verify the output voltage before connecting your load.

blocks.text: The EU Plug 18650 Lithium Battery Charger (Single Cell) is a compact wall-plug charger designed to safely recharge one 3.7V 18650 lithium-ion cell at a time. blocks.text: The 28BYJ-48 Stepper Motor with ULN2003 Driver Board Kit (5V) pairs a geared unipolar stepper motor with a matching driver board, giving makers precise, repeatable rotation for cameras, dials, and small mechanisms right out of the box.
