لوحة ESP32 Development Board 38 Pin هي لوحة تطوير قوية ومتعددة الاستخدامات، مناسبة لمشاريع إنترنت الأشياء (IoT)، والروبوتات، وأنظمة التحكم الذكية. بتتميز بمعالج قوي واتصال Wi-Fi وBluetooth مدمج في شريحة ESP32، مما يجعلها اختيارًا ممتازًا لتطوير المشاريع الإلكترونية والأنظمة المدمجة.
⭐ المميزات
معالج قوي: مناسب لتطبيقات التحكم ومعالجة البيانات.
Wi-Fi مدمج: للاتصال بالشبكات وتطوير تطبيقات إنترنت الأشياء.
Bluetooth مدمج: للتواصل اللاسلكي مع الأجهزة المتوافقة.
38 Pin: يوفّر مجموعة من أطراف الإدخال والإخراج لتوصيل الحساسات والمكونات الإلكترونية.
دعم Arduino IDE: لبرمجة اللوحة وتطوير المشاريع بسهولة.
حجم عملي: مناسب للمشاريع التعليمية والتطبيقات الاحترافية.
🔧 الاستخدامات
مشاريع إنترنت الأشياء (IoT).
أنظمة المنزل الذكي.
التحكم اللاسلكي في الأجهزة.
مشاريع الروبوتات.
قراءة بيانات الحساسات.
أنظمة المراقبة والتحكم عن بُعد.
تطبيقات الأتمتة والإلكترونيات المدمجة.
📦 محتويات العبوة
1 × ESP32 Development Board 38 Pin.
ملاحظة: عدد الأطراف والمواصفات التفصيلية قد تختلف حسب إصدار اللوحة والشريحة المستخدمة.
ESP32 Development Board 38 Pin – Wi-Fi & Bluetooth
🇬🇧 English Description

The ESP32 38-Pin Development Board is a versatile development platform designed for IoT, robotics, wireless communication, and embedded systems projects. Featuring integrated Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connectivity on compatible ESP32 variants, it is ideal for building smart and connected electronic applications.
⭐ Key Features
Powerful Processing: Suitable for control applications and data processing.
Built-in Wi-Fi: Enables wireless networking and IoT applications.
Bluetooth Connectivity: Supports wireless communication with compatible devices.
38-Pin Layout: Provides multiple GPIO connections for interfacing

name: Mini 12V DC Submersible Water Pump (R385)

blocks.text: The Mini 12V DC Submersible Water Pump is a compact R385-style diaphragm pump that moves water and other non-corrosive liquids using a small 12V DC motor. It is widely used in mini fountains, hydroponics, cooling loops, and other low-flow Arduino and Raspberry Pi automation projects.
Key features:
Operating Voltage: Runs from a 12V DC supply, drawing 0.5A to 0.7A under normal load and 0.18A at no load.
Flow Rate: Delivers approximately 1.5 to 2 litres per minute, enough for small fountains and irrigation drips.
Suction and Lift: Can self-prime with up to 2 metres of suction and lift water vertically up to 3 metres.
Compact Build: Measures about 90mm x 40mm x 35mm and weighs around 106g, so it fits easily inside small enclosures.
In/Out Barbed Outlets: Fitted with 6mm inlet and outlet barbs that accept standard flexible tubing.
Long Service Life: Rated for roughly 2500 hours of continuous operation and tolerates water up to 80°C.
Pair it with a relay or MOSFET driver to switch it from a microcontroller, since it draws more current than a GPIO pin can supply directly.

name: MFRC522 RFID Reader Module Kit (13.56MHz) with Card and Keyfob

blocks.text: The MFRC522 RFID Reader Module Kit is a 13.56MHz contactless reader/writer built around NXP’s MFRC522 IC, supplied with a MIFARE card and keyfob so testing can start right away. It communicates over SPI and is a common choice for access-control, attendance, and identification projects with Arduino, ESP32, and Raspberry Pi.
Key features:
Chipset: Uses the NXP MFRC522 controller, a proven, low-power IC for 13.56MHz contactless communication.
SPI Interface: Connects to any microcontroller SPI bus using SCK, MOSI, MISO and SDA/CS, plus IRQ, RST, GND and 3.3V.
Supply Voltage: Runs from a 3.3V supply; level shifting is required before connecting directly to 5V logic.
Read Range: Reads and writes MIFARE S50, S70, Ultralight and DESFire cards from a distance of up to 5cm.
Complete Starter Set: Includes one white RFID card and one keyfob, so no extra tags need to be bought to start testing.
ISO/IEC 14443A Compliant: Uses the same contactless protocol found in most access cards and public transport tags.
Its low cost and wide library support make this kit a straightforward way to add card- or tag-based access control to any microcontroller project.

name: CH341A USB Mini Programmer with SOIC8 Test Clip

blocks.text: The CH341A USB Mini Programmer is a low-cost flashing tool built around the CH341A chipset, used to read, write, and erase 24-series EEPROM and 25-series SPI flash chips directly from a PC. It is a common tool for BIOS recovery, router firmware repair, and general in-system chip programming.
Key Features
Chipset: Built around the CH341A USB-to-SPI/I2C bridge, a proven controller for low-level chip programming.
USB Interface: Connects to any PC via a standard USB port and is recognised as a serial/parallel adapter without extra drivers on most systems.
Dual Voltage Support: An onboard jumper switches the socket between 3.3V and 5V so both older and newer flash chips can be programmed safely.
Wide Chip Compatibility: Supports 24xx series EEPROM and 25xx series SPI flash chips in both 8-pin and 16-pin packages.
SOIC8 Test Clip Included: The bundled spring clip lets you program SOIC8 chips in-circuit without desoldering them from a board.
Software Support: Works with free programming tools such as AsProgrammer and flashrom on Windows and Linux.
Package Includes
1 x CH341A USB Programmer Board
1 x SOIC8 Test Clip Cable
1 x SOIC8 to DIP8 Adapter Board

name: 4×4 Matrix Membrane Keypad (16-Key)

blocks.text: The 4×4 Matrix Membrane Keypad is a thin, self-adhesive input pad with 16 keys (0-9, A-D, *, #) wired in a 4×4 matrix to minimize the number of microcontroller pins needed. Its flexible membrane construction and ribbon cable connector make it easy to mount on an enclosure and wire directly into Arduino or other microcontroller projects.
Key features:
16-Key Layout: Digits 0-9, letters A-D, and * / # symbols cover numeric entry and simple menu navigation.
4×4 Matrix Wiring: Only 8 microcontroller pins are needed to scan all 16 keys, saving I/O compared to individual buttons.
Thin Membrane Design: A slim, self-adhesive backing allows the keypad to be mounted flat on an enclosure or panel.
Flat Ribbon Connector: An 8-pin flat flexible cable connects directly to a breadboard-friendly header or Arduino shield.
Tactile Key Response: Each key gives a light tactile bump so presses can be felt without looking at the pad.
This keypad is a common choice for security keypad locks, calculators, and any project needing simple numeric or menu input.

name: PCA9685 16-Channel 12-Bit PWM/Servo Driver Module (I2C)

blocks.text: The PCA9685 16-Channel 12-Bit PWM/Servo Driver Module is an I2C-controlled breakout board built around the NXP PCA9685 IC, letting a single microcontroller drive up to 16 servos or PWM outputs using only two data lines. Onboard 12-bit resolution and an adjustable frequency range make it well suited for robotics, LED dimming, and multi-servo projects.
Key features:
16 PWM/Servo Outputs: Drives up to 16 independent servos or PWM channels from a single board.
I2C Control Interface: Communicates over just 2 pins (SDA/SCL), freeing up microcontroller I/O for other tasks.
12-Bit Resolution: 4096 steps per channel give smooth, precise servo positioning and LED dimming.
Cascadable Address Pins: Solder-selectable address jumpers allow up to 62 boards to share the same I2C bus for 992 outputs.
Onboard Screw Terminal: A dedicated power terminal lets servo power be supplied separately from logic power.
This module is a popular choice for robotic arms, hexapods, and any project that needs to control more servos than a microcontroller’s pins allow.

name: 4WD Smart Robot Car Chassis Kit with 4 DC Motors + Wheels + battery holder 4 cells wires

blocks.text: 4WD Robot Car Chassis Kit – 4 Motors & Wheels
🇪🇬 الوصف بالعربي

طقم 4WD Robot Car Chassis Kit هو مجموعة متكاملة لتجميع سيارة روبوت بأربع عجلات، مناسب لمشاريع الروبوتات والإلكترونيات والأنظمة الذكية. بيوفر الطقم المكونات الأساسية لبناء هيكل سيارة روبوت وتجهيزه للتحكم باستخدام Arduino أو ESP32 مع وحدات قيادة الموتورات المناسبة.
⭐ المميزات
4WD Drive System: أربع عجلات لقيادة السيارة والتحكم في حركتها.
4 DC Motors: أربعة موتور DC لتشغيل العجلات.
Robot Chassis: هيكل مناسب لتجميع سيارة روبوت.
Battery Holder: حامل بطاريات لتوفير مصدر طاقة للمشروع.
Connecting Wires: أسلاك للتوصيل بين المكونات.
🔧 الاستخدامات
مشاريع Arduino وESP32.
مشاريع الروبوتات التعليمية.
تصميم سيارات روبوت يتم التحكم فيها عن

name: 40-Pin Female to Male Dupont Jumper Wire Ribbon Cable (20cm)

blocks.text: The 40-Pin Female to Male Dupont Jumper Wire Ribbon Cable is a set of 40 individually separable wires, each terminated with a female Dupont socket on one end and a male pin header on the other. At 20cm long, it is the standard length for connecting breadboards, sensor modules, and GPIO headers on Arduino, Raspberry Pi, and other development boards.
Key features:
Female-to-Male Ends: One female Dupont connector and one male pin header per wire, ready to bridge a header pin to a breadboard or module socket.
40 Individual Wires: Each of the 40 conductors can be snapped off the ribbon and used separately as needed.
20cm Length: Long enough to route between a development board and nearby modules or breadboards.
2.54mm Pitch Connectors: Matches the standard header spacing used on Arduino, Raspberry Pi, and most breakout boards.
Color-Coded Wires: Multiple wire colors make it easy to trace connections in a busy build.
These jumpers are a prototyping essential, used in nearly every breadboard project to connect sensors, displays, and modules without any soldering.

name: TowerPro SG90 9g Micro Servo Motor (180°)

blocks.text: The TowerPro SG90 9g Micro Servo Motor is a lightweight, geared analog servo built around a 3-pole motor and plastic gear train, delivering precise 180-degree positional control for small robotics and RC projects. Its compact plastic case and standard 3-pin connector make it a drop-in choice for arms, grippers, pan-tilt mounts, and other lightweight mechanisms.
Key features:
180° Positional Control: A standard analog PWM control signal drives the servo to any angle within its 180-degree range.
Compact and Lightweight: Weighs only about 9g, making it ideal for small robots, RC aircraft, and gripper mechanisms.
Plastic Gear Train: Nylon gears keep cost and weight low while providing enough torque for light-duty linkages.
Wide Operating Voltage: Runs from 4.8V to 6V, compatible with most Arduino and hobby servo power setups.
Standard 3-Pin Connector: Plugs directly into common servo headers and hobby-grade receivers.
This servo is one of the most widely used motors in the maker community, prized for its low cost and reliable performance in everything from robot arms to camera pan-tilt rigs.

name: 8-Position Slide DIP Switch Module (2.54mm, Red)

blocks.text: The 8-Position Slide DIP Switch Module is a compact red 2.54mm-pitch switch array that combines eight independent SPST contacts in a single 16-pin package. Each slider locks ON or OFF individually, giving a permanent, tool-free way to set addresses, modes, or calibration options directly on a PCB or breadboard.
Key features:
Eight Independent Switches: Each of the 8 positions toggles its own circuit path, enough for a full byte of binary configuration.
Standard 2.54mm Pitch: 16 through-hole pins match standard breadboard, perfboard, and DIP socket spacing.
Clear ON/OFF Markings: A printed “ON” legend and numbered positions 1-8 make the current setting easy to read at a glance.
Positive Slide Action: Firm, tactile sliders hold their position reliably during handling and vibration.
Low-Voltage Signal Rated: Designed for logic-level switching in microcontroller, sensor, and hobby electronics circuits.
Eight switches in one compact block make it a space-efficient way to set device addresses or option bytes on Arduino, STM32, and other microcontroller projects.

name: 6-Position Slide DIP Switch Module (2.54mm, Red)

blocks.text: The 6-Position Slide DIP Switch Module is a compact red 2.54mm-pitch switch array that packs six independent SPST contacts into a single low-profile package. Each slider locks ON or OFF individually, giving makers a permanent, tool-free way to set addresses, modes, or calibration options directly on a PCB or breadboard.
Key features:
Six Independent Switches: Each of the 6 positions toggles its own circuit path, useful for binary addressing or multi-option configuration.
Standard 2.54mm Pitch: 12 through-hole pins match standard breadboard, perfboard, and DIP socket spacing.
Clear ON/OFF Markings: A printed “ON” legend and numbered positions 1-6 make the current setting easy to read.
Positive Slide Action: Firm, tactile sliders hold their position reliably during handling and vibration.
Low-Voltage Signal Rated: Designed for logic-level switching in microcontroller and hobby electronics circuits.
With six switches in one compact block, it is a space-efficient way to add multiple configuration options to Arduino, STM32, and other microcontroller projects.

name: 2-Position Slide DIP Switch Module (2.54mm, Red)

blocks.text: The 2-Position Slide DIP Switch Module is a compact red 2.54mm-pitch switch array used to set binary configuration options directly on a PCB or breadboard. Each of its two independently sliding contacts can be locked ON or OFF, giving a permanent, tool-free way to select modes, addresses, or calibration settings without extra jumpers or firmware changes.
Key features:
Two Independent Switches: Each position toggles its own SPST contact, letting you set two binary options on a single component.
Standard 2.54mm Pitch: Through-hole pins match standard breadboards, perfboards, and DIP sockets for drop-in mounting.
Clear ON/OFF Markings: A printed “ON” legend and numbered positions make the current state easy to read at a glance.
Positive Slide Action: The red housing gives each contact a firm, tactile click so settings stay put during handling and vibration.
Low-Voltage Signal Rated: Suited to logic-level switching in microcontroller, sensor, and hobby electronics projects.
This switch is a handy addition to any prototyping bench, letting hobbyists configure circuits the same way commercial PCBs use DIP switches for factory settings.

name: 1-Way DIP Switch (SPST Slide Switch)

blocks.text: The 1-Way DIP Switch is a compact single-position SPST slide switch housed in a red through-hole package, designed to set a fixed on/off configuration directly on a PCB. It is a simple, low-cost way to add manual configuration or address selection to a circuit.
Key features:
Single SPST Position: One slide contact provides a simple on/off toggle for configuring a circuit.
Through-Hole Mounting: Two gold-plated pins solder directly onto a standard 2.54mm-pitch PCB footprint.
Clear ON Markings: The molded housing is printed with ON/OFF labels so the switch state is easy to read at a glance.
Compact Footprint: A small red plastic housing keeps the switch unobtrusive on crowded boards.
Durable Construction: Gold-plated contacts resist corrosion and support repeated switching cycles.
Low-Voltage Rated: Suitable for typical logic-level and low-current configuration circuits.

name: Water Level Detection Sensor Module

blocks.text: The Water Level Detection Sensor Module is a low-cost analog sensor that uses a comb pattern of nickel-plated traces to measure water level or detect the presence of liquid. It is a common choice for rain gauges, tank-level monitors and simple liquid-detection projects.
Key features:
Analog Output: Produces a voltage that rises as more of the conductive traces are submerged, giving a graduated water-level reading.
Corrosion-Resistant Traces: Nickel-plated exposed traces resist oxidation for more consistent long-term readings.
Simple 3-Pin Interface: VCC, GND and analog signal (S) connect directly to any microcontroller’s analog input.
Compact, Lightweight Board: A small PCB strip that mounts easily inside tanks, trays or drip pans.
Low Power Draw: Draws only a small operating current, making it suitable for battery-powered projects.
Wide Compatibility: Works with Arduino, ESP8266, ESP32 and other 3.3V-5V microcontroller boards.

name: MQ-5 LPG and Natural Gas Sensor Module

blocks.text: The MQ-5 LPG and Natural Gas Sensor Module uses an MQ-5 tin-dioxide sensing element to detect LPG, natural gas, town gas and methane. It is a straightforward, low-cost option for home gas-leak alarms and combustible-gas monitoring projects.
Key features:
Targeted Gas Detection: Highly sensitive to LPG, natural gas, town gas and methane, with lower sensitivity to alcohol and smoke.
Wide Concentration Range: Detects combustible gas concentrations from roughly 200 to 10,000 ppm.
Dual Signal Output: Provides an analog output (AO) for concentration level and a digital output (DO) for threshold alerts.
Adjustable Sensitivity: An onboard potentiometer sets the digital trigger point.
Fast Response and Recovery: Reacts quickly to rising gas levels and recovers once the gas clears.
Standard 4-Pin Header: VCC, GND, DO and AO pins connect directly to Arduino, ESP32 or similar boards.

name: MQ-2 Smoke and Flammable Gas Sensor Module

blocks.text: The MQ-2 Smoke and Flammable Gas Sensor Module uses an MQ-2 tin-dioxide sensing element to detect smoke together with LPG, propane, butane, methane, alcohol and hydrogen gas. It is a popular low-cost choice for home gas-leak alarms and smoke-detection projects.
Key features:
Multi-Gas Detection: Senses smoke and combustible gases including LPG, propane, butane, methane and hydrogen.
Wide Concentration Range: Detects gas concentrations from roughly 200 to 10,000 ppm.
Dual Signal Output: Provides an analog output (AO) for concentration level and a digital output (DO) for threshold alerts.
Adjustable Sensitivity: An onboard potentiometer sets the digital trigger threshold.
Fast Response: Reacts within seconds to rising gas or smoke levels.
Standard 4-Pin Header: VCC, GND, DO and AO pins wire directly to Arduino and similar microcontroller boards.

name: MQ-135 Air Quality Gas Sensor Module

blocks.text: The MQ-135 Air Quality Gas Sensor Module uses an MQ-135 tin-dioxide sensing element to detect a broad range of harmful gases, including ammonia, NOx, benzene, smoke and CO2. It is widely used in indoor air-quality monitors and gas-leak alarm projects.
Key features:
Broad Gas Detection: Senses ammonia, sulphide, benzene, smoke and CO2 with good sensitivity across a wide concentration range.
Dual Signal Output: Provides an analog output (AO) for concentration readings and a digital output (DO) for threshold alerts.
Adjustable Sensitivity: An onboard potentiometer sets the digital output trigger point.
Stable, Long Life: The sealed sensing element offers long-term stability and a long service life under continuous operation.
Fast Response: Reacts quickly to changing gas concentrations, making it suitable for real-time monitoring.
Standard 4-Pin Header: VCC, GND, DO and AO pins connect straight to Arduino, ESP32 or Raspberry Pi.

name: Sound Detection Sensor Module 4-Pin

blocks.text: The Sound Detection Sensor Module is a 4-pin electret-microphone sensor built around the LM393 comparator, designed to detect ambient sound and trigger a digital output once a set volume threshold is crossed. It suits clap switches, noise-activated alarms and sound-reactive lighting projects.
Key features:
Electret Microphone: Picks up ambient sound and converts it into an analog voltage proportional to volume.
Dual Signal Output: Provides an analog output (AO) for sound level and a digital output (DO) that switches once the threshold is exceeded.
LM393 Comparator: Delivers a fast, stable digital trigger signal free of noise.
Adjustable Sensitivity: An onboard potentiometer sets the detection threshold to match the environment.
Compact 4-Pin Header: VCC, GND, DO and AO pins connect directly to Arduino, ESP8266 or other microcontroller boards.
Status LED: An onboard indicator lights up whenever the digital output is triggered.

name: IR Flame Detection Sensor Module

blocks.text: The IR Flame Detection Sensor Module is a compact infrared-based sensor built around the LM393 voltage comparator, designed to detect open flame and other infrared light sources between 760nm and 1100nm. It gives early warning of fire hazards in robotics, home safety and industrial monitoring projects.
Key features:
Infrared Flame Detection: Detects open flame or infrared radiation from up to about 100cm away, with sensitivity that decreases as the flame size shrinks.
Dual Signal Output: Delivers a digital output (DO) for simple flame/no-flame alerts and an analog output (AO) for measuring flame intensity.
LM393 Comparator: Converts the sensor’s IR signal into a clean, stable digital signal with a fast response time.
Adjustable Sensitivity: An onboard potentiometer lets you tune the detection threshold for the surrounding light conditions.
Wide Detection Angle: Senses flame sources within roughly a 60° cone in front of the sensor head.
Status Indicators: Onboard power and digital-output LEDs make wiring and testing quick and simple.

name: STI8036 LNB Power Supply & Control Voltage Regulator IC (SOP-8)

blocks.text: The STI8036 LNB Power Supply & Control Voltage Regulator IC (SOP-8) is a monolithic boost converter and linear regulator that powers a satellite dish LNB (low-noise block downconverter) from a set-top box or satellite receiver. It supplies the switched 14V/19V rail and 22kHz tone signal used to select LNB polarity and band.
Key features:
Dual Output Voltage: Switches between a regulated 14V and 19V output to select LNB polarity.
22kHz Tone Injection: Generates the 22kHz tone signal used for LNB band switching and DiSEqC-style control.
Integrated Boost Converter: Combines a DC/DC boost stage with a low-noise linear regulator on a single chip.
500mA Output Current: Delivers enough current to power a standard single or twin LNB.
Compact SOP-8 Package: Small surface-mount footprint drops directly into existing satellite receiver and STB PCB designs.
Built-In Protection: Includes thermal shutdown and current-limit protection for reliable field operation.
A common repair and replacement part for satellite receivers, set-top boxes and satellite TV cards.

name: 2-Channel 5V Relay Module (Optocoupled, for Arduino/PIC/ARM)

blocks.text: The 2-Channel 5V Relay Module (Optocoupled, for Arduino/PIC/ARM) is a compact two-relay interface board that lets microcontrollers such as Arduino, PIC, ARM, AVR and DSP boards switch higher-voltage or higher-current loads. Each channel uses an optocoupler-isolated SPDT relay so the control-side logic stays fully separated from the switched circuit.
Key features:
Two Independent Channels: Controls two separate AC or DC loads from one small board.
Optocoupler Isolation: Keeps microcontroller logic pins electrically isolated from the relay coil and switched load.
5V Logic Trigger: Compatible with standard 3.3V/5V microcontroller outputs including Arduino, PIC, ARM, AVR and DSP.
10A Relay Rating: Each SPDT relay is rated up to 10A at 250VAC or 10A at 30VDC.
Screw Terminal Outputs: NO/COM/NC screw terminals make load wiring quick and solder-free.
Compact Layout: Small footprint fits easily inside enclosures or alongside other modules on a project board.
A handy building block for automation, remote switching and any beginner-to-intermediate project that needs to control mains or DC loads from a microcontroller.

name: 4-Channel 5V Relay Module (Active Low, Optocoupled)

blocks.text: The 4-Channel 5V Relay Module (Active Low, Optocoupled) is a four-relay interface board that lets a microcontroller switch mains-voltage or high-current DC loads safely and independently. Each of the four 10A relays is driven through an optocoupler, isolating the logic-side control signals from the switched load.
Key features:
Four Independent Channels: Switches up to four separate AC or DC loads from a single board.
Optocoupler Isolation: Each channel is optically isolated, protecting the controlling microcontroller from load-side noise and voltage spikes.
Active-Low Trigger: Pulling an IN pin low energises its relay, matching common Arduino and Raspberry Pi relay libraries.
High Current Rating: Relays are rated up to 10A at 250VAC or 10A at 30VDC per channel.
Screw Terminal Blocks: Each relay has a labelled screw terminal for safe, solderless load wiring.
Status LEDs: Onboard LEDs indicate the on/off state of every channel at a glance.
Well suited for home automation, appliance control, industrial switching and any project that needs to drive multiple higher-power loads from logic-level signals.

name: Blank RFID Card 13.56MHz MIFARE Classic (10-Pack)

blocks.text: The Blank RFID Card 13.56MHz MIFARE Classic (10-Pack) is a set of writable, credit-card-sized proximity cards designed for access control and identification systems. Each card carries a MIFARE Classic 1K chip that can be programmed with an RFID reader/writer module such as the MFRC522.
Key features:
Chip: MIFARE Classic 1K, ISO 14443 Type A compliant.
Frequency: 13.56 MHz, compatible with standard RFID reader modules.
Material: Durable white PVC, blank and ready for printing or labeling.
Read/Write: Fully rewritable memory for custom access codes and data.
Form Factor: Standard 85.6mm x 54mm credit-card size.
These cards are ideal for building custom door access systems, attendance tracking, and RFID-based identification projects with Arduino or Raspberry Pi.

name: Solderless Breadboard Jumper Wire Kit (140 Pieces, U-Shape)

blocks.text: The Solderless Breadboard Jumper Wire Kit (140 Pieces, U-Shape) is a set of pre-formed, pre-stripped jumper wires for building circuits on a solderless breadboard without hand-cutting or stripping wire. Each piece is bent to a fixed length and colour-coded, so components click into place quickly and cleanly.
Key Features
140-Piece Set: Includes assorted pre-formed lengths to cover short and long breadboard connections.
U-Shape Design: Rigid 22AWG wire is bent and trimmed to sit flush in standard 2.54mm breadboard holes.
Colour-Coded Lengths: Different colours correspond to different wire lengths for fast circuit tracing.
Tinned Copper Pins: Solid tinned-copper ends give a firm grip and reliable contact in breadboard sockets.
No Stripping Required: Ready to use straight out of the case, saving prep time on every build.
Package Includes
140 x U-Shape Jumper Wires (Assorted Lengths)
1 x Plastic Storage Case

name: TT Gear Motor with 65mm Yellow Wheel (3-12VDC, Dual Shaft)

blocks.text: The TT Gear Motor with 65mm Yellow Wheel is a dual-shaft DC gearmotor pre-fitted with a rubber-tired 65mm wheel, built for small robot chassis and DIY vehicle projects. It runs on 3 to 12VDC and delivers steady low-speed torque through an internal gearbox, with a two-flat output shaft on the free side for a second wheel or encoder disc.
Key features:
Wide Voltage Range: Operates from 3V to 12VDC, with speed and torque scaling with the supply voltage.
Geared for Torque: Internal gearbox trades top speed for strong low-end torque, ideal for driving small chassis.
Dual D-Shaft Output: A second 2-flat shaft on the motor body lets you add an encoder disc or a matching wheel.
65mm Wheel Included: Pre-mounted rubber-tired yellow wheel gives immediate traction with no extra assembly.
Compact TT Form Factor: Standard TT gearmotor mounting matches common two- and four-wheel robot chassis kits.
Lightweight Build: Plastic gearbox housing keeps the total weight low for battery-powered robots.
A drop-in choice for line-following robots, obstacle-avoidance cars and other wheeled robotics builds.

name: Battery Capacity & Voltage Indicator LCD Panel Meter (12V-84V)

blocks.text: The Battery Capacity & Voltage Indicator LCD Panel Meter is a GY-6 series digital gauge that reads out remaining charge and live voltage for 12V-84V lead-acid, Li-ion and LiFePO4 battery packs. Its bright green backlit LCD shows both a battery-bar percentage and the exact voltage, connected with just two wires.
Key features:
Dual Readout: Displays battery percentage as a bar graph alongside the live pack voltage on the same green LCD screen.
Wide Voltage Range: Monitors packs from 8V up to 100V, covering common 12V, 24V, 36V, 48V, 60V, 72V and 84V systems.
Multi-Chemistry Support: Configurable for lead-acid, Li-ion, LiPo and LiFePO4 battery types.
Simple 2-Wire Hookup: Connects with just a red and black wire pair directly across the battery terminals.
Panel-Mount Housing: Compact black enclosure snap-fits into a dashboard or equipment panel cutout.
Push-Button Calibration: Front buttons set the battery type and reset the percentage reading.
Ideal for e-bikes, golf carts, solar setups, UPS systems and any DIY project that needs an at-a-glance battery status readout.

name: 16×2 Character LCD Display Module (Blue Backlight)

blocks.text: The 16×2 Character LCD Display Module (Blue Backlight) is a HD44780-compatible alphanumeric display for showing text on Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi and other microcontroller projects. Its blue background with white characters gives crisp, high-contrast visibility for sensor readings, menus and status messages.
Key features:
